name: spin-wheel
summary: A prize wheel whose flapper ticks over every divider as it eases onto the win.
props: 2–16 prizes, clockwise from the pointer. Long labels shrink or wrap to fit; weight sets the odds of a random pick (0 never wins at random).
Fills for segments without a color; the text picks black or white to read on each.
Full turns before it lands (a harder flick adds a few).
Length of a spin in ms: a fast launch, a long slow crawl and a tiny settle.
Decide the prize (e.g. on your server). The wheel keeps spinning while the promise is pending, then lands on it. Without it, weight picks at random.
A spin began (tap, flick or ref).
The wheel landed; the winning wedge glows until the next spin.
getResult threw, rejected or gave an invalid index; the wheel coasts to a stop with no winner.
Metal of the rim, pins and dividers.
Ignore taps, flicks and ref.spin(); dims the hub and the lights.
A tick per divider, a tap on the hub and a success buzz on landing.
Screen-reader name; the prizes and the result are read after it, and the result is announced.
Spin from your own button (optionally onto a fixed index), or cancel and turn back to the start.
behavior: Tap the SPIN hub or flick the wheel; a harder flick throws it further. A slow drag just springs back to rest.
It keeps turning while getResult resolves, then eases onto the chosen wedge; the other wedges dim and the winner glows while the rim lights flash.
The idle chasing lights, the win celebration and the winner pulse are skipped; the spin itself still plays.
A selection tick each time the flapper crosses a divider, a light impact on the hub, and a success notification on the win (skipped on web).
The wheel is an image whose label lists every prize; the hub is a button with busy state while spinning, and the result is announced.
